verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents PyAirbyte, an official Python library aimed at Python and AI developers, which extracts data from sources and loads it into caches. This is a first-party SDK, but only one language is evidenced and its scope is data extraction rather than full programmatic control of the platform. missing for 10: official SDKs in multiple languages wrapping the Airbyte API, documentation showing the SDK covers platform/connection management, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: PyAirbyte brings the power of Airbyte to every Python and AI developer.
Data can be extracted from sources and loaded into caches
